Title: Create missing sub-category if meaningful and absent
Preconditions: Migration script configured with GeneralMasters lookup.
Steps: Run migration for tests. | Pick source rows where target sub-category code does not exist in GeneralMasters. | Verify missing valid SCTG rows are created.
Expected Result: Meaningful missing sub-categories are auto-created and assigned.

Title: Keep sub-category blank when test name equals sub-category name
Steps: Run migration for rows where normalized TestName equals normalized SubCategoryName. | Inspect destination TestMasters rows.
Expected Result: SubCategoryCode remains null/blank for such rows.

Title: Reject nonsense sub-category names
Steps: Run migration on records with nonsense candidate names. | Inspect GeneralMasters and TestMasters outputs.
Expected Result: Nonsense names are not created and not assigned to tests.

Title: Reuse existing DEPT/CTGY/SCTG masters before creating new
Steps: Run migration. | Verify existing codes are reused and duplicates are not created.
Expected Result: Mapping prefers existing masters; only valid missing rows are inserted.
